title.english: Waiting for the Wall to Dry

pairs.target: cìrì zǎochén ,
pairs.english: The following morning,

pairs.target: nà zhī láng hái zài kùfáng lǐ ,
pairs.english: that wolf was still in the storeroom,

pairs.target: yuànqiáng shàng què duō le yígè tànhuà de lángtóu .
pairs.english: but a wolf head drawn in charcoal had appeared on the courtyard wall.
pairs.hanzi: 院墙上却多了一个炭画的狼头。

pairs.target: huà tā de rén méi huà yǎnjīng ,
pairs.english: Whoever drew it had left out the eyes,

pairs.target: zhī zài zuǐbiān tiān le sāndào wān xiàn .
pairs.english: adding only three curved lines near the mouth.
pairs.hanzi: 只在嘴边添了三道弯线。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tíngxiàlái ,
pairs.english: Tavi stopped,

pairs.target: kàn le bàntiān ,
pairs.english: looked for quite a while,

pairs.target: cái rènchū nà shì zuówǎn nà shēng láng jiào .
pairs.english: and finally recognized it as last night's howl.
pairs.hanzi: 才认出那是昨晚那声狼叫。

pairs.target: tā zhèng xiǎng zhǎo kuài bù bǎ huà cādiào ,
pairs.english: He was just about to find a cloth and wipe off the drawing,
pairs.hanzi: 他正想找块布把画擦掉，

pairs.target: shǒu yuàn de lǎorén tí zhe sàozhou guòlái le .
pairs.english: when the old yard keeper came by carrying a broom.
pairs.hanzi: 守院的老人提着扫帚过来了。

pairs.target: lǎorén ràng tā xiān bié cā ,
pairs.english: The old man told him not to wipe it yet.

pairs.target: qiáng dǐ de shíhuī hái méi gān ,
pairs.english: The limewash at the bottom of the wall hadn't dried yet.

pairs.target: ná shībù yìmǒ ,
pairs.english: One swipe with a wet cloth,

pairs.target: huī yě dé gēnzhe xiàlái .
pairs.english: and the lime would come off with it.

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wèn nà huà zěnmebàn .
pairs.english: Tavi asked what to do about the drawing.

pairs.target: lǎorén yòng sàozhou bǐng zhǐ le zhǐ láng xià : "
pairs.english: The old man pointed toward the corridor with the broom handle.
pairs.hanzi: 老人用扫帚柄指了指廊下：“

pairs.target: děng tā gān .
pairs.english: “Wait for it to dry.

pairs.target: yòu búshì láng zài děng nǐ . "
pairs.english: It isn't as if the wolf were waiting for you.”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi qù zhǎo jiǎn lǎoshī jiāo biǎo .
pairs.english: Tavi went to find Instructor Jian and hand in the form.

pairs.target: lǎoshī zhuōshàng yā zhe yìfēng méi fēngkǒu de xìn ,
pairs.english: A letter not yet sealed lay weighted down on the teacher's desk,
pairs.hanzi: 老师桌上压着一封没封口的信，

pairs.target: xìnzhǐ de yìjiǎo lù zài wàimiàn .
pairs.english: with one corner of the paper sticking out.

pairs.target: tā jiāng zìjǐ de biǎo bǎi dào lìngyìbiān ,
pairs.english: He set his own form to the other side,
pairs.hanzi: 他将自己的表摆到另一边，

pairs.target: miǎnde bǎ liǎngzhāng zhǐ yídào tuījìn qù .
pairs.english: so as not to push the two sheets in together.
pairs.hanzi: 免得把两张纸一道推进去。

pairs.target: jiǎn lǎoshī méi kàn biǎo ,
pairs.english: Instructor Jian didn't look at the form.

pairs.target: xiān wèn tā jīnrì xiǎng zuò shénme .
pairs.english: First she asked what he wanted to do today.

pairs.target: tā běn xiǎng shuō hái xiǎng zǒu yìhuí ,
pairs.english: He had meant to say he wanted to make another run,

pairs.target: huàdàozuǐbiān ,
pairs.english: but with the words on his lips,

pairs.target: xiǎngqǐ pà wò zuóyè shōuqǐ mùjià shí ,
pairs.english: he remembered Pavo putting the frame away last night,
pairs.hanzi: 想起帕沃昨夜收起木架时，

pairs.target: bìng méiyǒu shuō yào zàiyǎn gěi tā kàn .
pairs.english: and that he hadn't said he'd put the show on again for him.
pairs.hanzi: 并没有说要再演给他看。

pairs.target: tā gǎikǒu wèn , néng bunéng qù wèn dāngbān de rén ,
pairs.english: Instead he asked if he could go ask the person on duty
pairs.hanzi: 他改口问，能不能去问当班的人，

pairs.target: kànkàn péng ménbiān de jiāzi píngrì zěnme yòng ,
pairs.english: and see how the clip by the shelter door was usually used.
pairs.hanzi: 看看棚门边的夹子平日怎么用，

pairs.target: zhī kàn tāmen zìjǐ zěnyàng qǔ zhǐ ,
pairs.english: He'd only watch how they took down their own notes,
pairs.hanzi: 只看他们自己怎样取纸，

pairs.target: bù qǐng tāmen wèi zìjǐ liúhuà .
pairs.english: without asking them to leave any message for him.

pairs.target: jiǎn lǎoshī zhè cái fānkāi tā de biǎo .
pairs.english: Only then did Instructor Jian open his form.
pairs.hanzi: 简老师这才翻开他的表。

pairs.target: tā kàn wán nà yìháng guānyú bèizi de zì ,
pairs.english: She finished reading the words on that line about the quilt
pairs.hanzi: 她看完那一行关于被子的字，

pairs.target: jiào tā qù wèn duàn yí yuànbuyuànyì ,
pairs.english: and told him to go ask Auntie Duan if she was willing.
pairs.hanzi: 叫他去问段姨愿不愿意，

pairs.target: ruò rén bú zài ,
pairs.english: If she wasn't there,

pairs.target: jiù xiān huílái .
pairs.english: he should just come back first.

pairs.target: nà búshì jiào tā zài pénglǐ hòu zhe ,
pairs.english: That didn't mean he should hang around in the shelter
pairs.hanzi: 那不是叫他在棚里候着，

pairs.target: děngdào yǒurén kěn dāying wéizhǐ .
pairs.english: until somebody was willing to agree.

pairs.target: chūménshí ,
pairs.english: On his way out,

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zài láng xià yùjiàn le mǐlā .
pairs.english: Tavi met Mira in the corridor.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维在廊下遇见了米拉。

pairs.target: tā bào zhe yíkuài fèi mù ,
pairs.english: She was holding a piece of scrap wood,

pairs.target: wèn tā xiàwǔ néng bunéng tì tā kàn yìyǎn kǒng shì zěnme mó piān de .
pairs.english: and asked if he could take a look that afternoon at how the hole had worn off center.
pairs.hanzi: 问他下午能不能替她看一眼孔是怎么磨偏的。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō kěyǐ ,
pairs.english: Tavi said he could,

pairs.target: búguò yào děng tā cóng pénglǐ huílái .
pairs.english: but she'd have to wait until he got back from the shelter.
pairs.hanzi: 不过要等他从棚里回来。

pairs.target: mǐlā wèn ruò duàn yí bú zài ne .
pairs.english: Mira asked, what if Auntie Duan wasn't there?

pairs.target: tā shuō nà jiù huílái de gèng zǎo .
pairs.english: He said he'd get back even earlier then.

pairs.target: mǐlā tīng le xiào qǐlái ,
pairs.english: Mira laughed when she heard that

pairs.target: bǎ fèi mù huàn dào lìngyìzhī shǒulǐ ,
pairs.english: and shifted the scrap wood to her other hand.
pairs.hanzi: 把废木换到另一只手里，

pairs.target: shuō zhè dǎo shì gè tā tīngdédǒng de shíchén .
pairs.english: Now that, she said, was a time she could understand.
pairs.hanzi: 说这倒是个她听得懂的时辰。

pairs.target: liǎng rén zài lóutīkǒu fēnkāi .
pairs.english: They parted at the stairs.

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yánzhe yuànqiáng zǒu ,
pairs.english: Tavi walked along the courtyard wall.

pairs.target: jīngguò nàge lángtóu shí ,
pairs.english: As he passed the wolf's head,

pairs.target: jiàn tàn xiàn xiàmiàn yǐjīng gān chū yìquān qiǎnbái .
pairs.english: he saw that the wall had already dried into a pale ring beneath the charcoal lines.
pairs.hanzi: 见炭线下面已经干出一圈浅白。

pairs.target: tā méi shēnshǒu shì ,
pairs.english: He didn't reach out to test it,

pairs.target: zhǐ jiāng xiùkǒu zhān zhe de yìdiǎn fěnbǐhuī pāidiào .
pairs.english: only brushing off the bit of chalk dust clinging to his cuff.
pairs.hanzi: 只将袖口沾着的一点粉笔灰拍掉。

pairs.target: fěnbǐhuī suífēng luòdào qiánggēn ,
pairs.english: The chalk dust drifted down to the foot of the wall in the wind,

pairs.target: láng zuǐbiān de sāndào xiàn réng liúzài nàlǐ .
pairs.english: but the three lines by the wolf's mouth stayed right there.
pairs.hanzi: 狼嘴边的三道线仍留在那里。
